programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Ticino"
programme.desc: Learn about four different regions of Switzerland. From the rugged mountains of the Ticino High Alps to the lovely Muggio Valley in the southernmost corner of Ticino, hardly any other canton is so full of contrasts.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Water and Ice"
programme.desc: The river called Aare is the only body of water that runs through Switzerland. It rises from a source in the Bernese Alps and finally flows into the Rhine. The Aere offers an important habitat for flora and fauna.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Thar Desert : Sacred Sands"
programme.desc: Covering 125,000 square miles, India's Thar desert is one of the harshest places on Earth. Desiccating winds and a near-permanent drought has earned this unforgiving land another name: the region of death.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Ganges: River of Life"
programme.desc: The Ganges is the longest river in India. It flows from the glaciers of the Himalayas all the way down to the Bay of Bengal. It's a lifeline to wild animals, from rhinoceros and river dolphins to otters and gharial crocodiles.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "The Himalayas: Surviving the Summits"
programme.desc: The Himalayas run across 1550 miles of north India. The Himalayas' rugged highlands offer little direct refuge to humans, and in the shadow below, over a billion people in India rely on the mountains for survival.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Western Ghats: Monsoon Mountains'"
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are a spine of mountains that lay claim to being one of the most biodiverse places in the world. In the east, tigers and wild dogs compete for prey. All the while, the western Ghats hold the key to life across southern India.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "India’s Lost World"
programme.desc: Northeast India is an anthropological paradise; there is no other place on Earth with so many different ethnic groups. The forests are filled with mysterious tribes whose lives are dictated by the rain and the seasonal fruits of the forest.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "A.I. The Code For Consiousness?"
programme.desc: Hollywood has made us rather fearful of Artificial Intelligence, or A.I. But as we shall see, A.I. and its dance partner robotics might not be the nemesis we should fear; at least, not if we get them right.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Germ Warefare"
programme.desc: A new enemy is emerging. This new enemy is the natural world itself, a microscopic realm of bacteria. And not just any bacteria, but the so-called super-bugs. We'll look at the emerging threats and what scientists are doing to counter them.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Nuclear 2.0"
programme.desc: To mitigate this climate emergency, we must use all of the tools at our disposal, like the Nuclear Energy. This documentary looks at the new safer nuclear technology and how it could be utilised in a coal burning country like Australia.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "100 Million Year Old Secrets Revealed"
programme.desc: We look at a newly discovered and oldest existing mammal tail preserved in Amber and being studied by scientists.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Doncaster"
programme.desc: In this episode an intensive operation takes place to bring down a huge and unusual structure.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Bridges: City Icons"
programme.desc: Here are ten of the world greatest modern bridges - engineering marvels and architectural masterpieces from around the world.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Transport Megastructures-Engineering Wonders"
programme.desc: The Trans-Siberian Railway, New York City Subway, Channel Tunnel and Suez Canal are only some of the breathtaking megastructures devised by humanity.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "TV Towers: Complex and Gracious"

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Stadiums: Stunning Arenas"

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"

programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programme.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.
